## Documentary evidence map — not executable business integration
Audit SHA 26a9f6549ece44e0f17c50e453c23a0fc076071a
Final report: audit/final-integration-20261111/README.md
This map uses conceptual arrows in note text only. No executable connections, triggers, noOp, schedules, credentials or calls exist. Each connection ID/status/evidence comes directly from the named audit inventories; definitive detail and limitations remain in those files. Notes group Android, server business, operations/Flow/legacy and n8n. VERIFIED_PASS applies only to each stated verification scope, never universal release readiness.
Previous architecture-map domain boundaries reused; stale labels and conceptual noOp representation replaced. Live workflows preserved.
